lines.en: Lesson 29
lines.zh: 第29课

lines.en: Funny or not?
lines.zh: 好笑与否？

lines.en: What is the basis of 'sick' humour?
lines.zh: “病态”幽默的基础是什么？

lines.en: Whether we find a joke funny or not largely depends on where we have been brought up.
lines.zh: 我们觉得一个笑话好不好笑，在很大程度上取决于我们是在哪里长大的。

lines.en: The sense of humour is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.
lines.zh: 幽默感与民族特点有着神秘的联系。

lines.en: A Frenchman, for instance, might find it hard to laugh at a Russian joke.
lines.zh: 例如，法国人可能觉得俄罗斯笑话不好笑。

lines.en: In the same way, a Russian might fail to see anything amusing in a joke
lines.zh: 同样，俄罗斯人可能觉得一个笑话没什么可乐的，

lines.en: which would make an Englishman laugh to tears.
lines.zh: 而这个笑话却能让英国人捧腹大笑。

lines.en: Most funny stories are based on comic situations.
lines.zh: 大多数有趣的故事都基于滑稽的情境。

lines.en: In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal.
lines.zh: 尽管存在民族差异，但某些滑稽情境具有普遍的吸引力。

lines.en: No matter where you live,
lines.zh: 无论你住在哪里，

lines.en: you would find it difficult not to laugh at, say, Charlie Chaplin's early films.
lines.zh: 你都会觉得很难不对，比如说，查理·卓别林的早期电影发笑。

lines.en: However, a new type of humour, which stems largely from U.S., has recently come into fashion.
lines.zh: 然而，一种主要源自美国的幽默新类型，最近流行起来。

lines.en: It is called 'sick humour'. Comedians base their jokes on tragic situations like violent death or serious accidents.
lines.zh: 它被称为“病态幽默”。喜剧演员将他们的笑话建立在悲剧情境上，例如暴力死亡或严重事故。

lines.en: Many people find this sort of joke distasteful.
lines.zh: 许多人觉得这种笑话令人反感。

lines.en: The following example of 'sick humour' will enable you to judge for yourself.
lines.zh: 下面这个“病态幽默”的例子能让你自己评判。

lines.en: A man who had broken his right leg was taken to hospital a few weeks before Christmas.
lines.zh: 一个右腿骨折的男人在圣诞节前几周被送进了医院。

lines.en: From the moment he arrived there,
lines.zh: 从他到达那里那一刻起，

lines.en: he kept on pestering his doctor to tell him when he would be able to go home.
lines.zh: 他就一直缠着医生，问他什么时候能回家。

lines.en: He dreaded having to spend Christmas in hospital.
lines.zh: 他害怕不得不在医院过圣诞节。

lines.en: Though the doctor did his best, the patient's recovery was slow.
lines.zh: 尽管医生尽了力，但病人的康复很慢。

lines.en: On Christmas day, the man still had his right leg in plaster.
lines.zh: 圣诞节那天，这个男人右腿上仍然打着石膏。

lines.en: He spent a miserable day in bed thinking of all the fun he was missing.
lines.zh: 他在床上度过了悲惨的一天，想着自己错过了所有的乐趣。

lines.en: The following day, however, the doctor consoled him by telling him
lines.zh: 然而，第二天，医生安慰他说，

lines.en: that his chances of being able to leave hospital in time for New Year celebrations were good.
lines.zh: 他赶在新年庆祝活动前出院的可能性很大。

lines.en: The man took heart and sure enough, on New Year's Eve he was able to hobble along to a party.
lines.zh: 男人振作起来，果然，在除夕夜他能一瘸一拐地去参加派对。

lines.en: To compensate for his unpleasant experiences in hospital,
lines.zh: 为了弥补他在医院的不愉快经历，

lines.en: the man drank a little more than was good for him.
lines.zh: 他多喝了一点酒，这对他身体不好。

lines.en: In the process, he enjoyed himself thoroughly and kept telling everybody how much he hated hospitals.
lines.zh: 在此过程中，他玩得很开心，并且不停地告诉所有人他有多么讨厌医院。

lines.en: He was still mumbling something about hospitals at the end of the party when he slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg.
lines.zh: 派对结束时，他还在嘟囔着关于医院的事情，这时他滑到了一块冰上，摔断了左腿。
